blends.name: Blockchain Stream Team Freebie hunter NTT!
blends.desc:
Welcome to the Blockchain Stream Team! 

This NTT (and verification with WaxPortal bot) will give you prioritised discord pings to freebies posted in our discord from all manor of collections! 

This is on-top of all the giveaways from BST streamers, Rumble Token giveaways and public giveaways! 

Join us; https://discord.com/invite/PKn8JFjp6w. 

The reason for this NTT is to ensure giveaway pings go to those who want them.

blends.name: Streamer Coin in Case to 1 of 1 Art blend
blends.desc:
This blend is to trade a streamer coin for a 1 of 1 art NFT of random design. 

There are only 10 available but we may add more later. 

You will be able to swap your art NFTs back to a streamer coin in case when required but this will be random and you may not get the streamer you put in. 

There will be a small Wax fee (0.25 Wax) on the transaction to cover gas both ways.

blends.name: LasVegasApe Streamer Fragment Blend
